1.overview: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Andy's birthday brings Buzz Lightyear onto the scene. Woody is convinced he is Andy's favorite toy, but Buzz quickly wins everyone over. When Woody and Buzz find themselves lost in the outside world, they must work together to find their way home.

2.overview: When siblings Judy and Peter discover an enchanted board game that opens the door to a magical world, they unwittingly invite Alan, an adult who's been trapped inside its jungle for 26 years, into their living room. Together they must outrun rampaging wild animals to finish the game.

296.overview: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper. Their adventures unfurl in three eccentric, non-linear stories.

318.overview: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden and forms an enduring friendship with fellow inmate Red.

356.overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events—in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined possible. Yet despite all he has achieved, his one true love eludes him.

480.overview: A wealthy entrepreneur secretly creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening day, he invites a team of experts and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park and help calm anxious investors, but a security breach unleashes terror.

593.overview: Clarice Starling is a top student at the FBI's training academy. Jack Crawford wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath serving life behind bars for cannibalism, to help catch a twisted serial killer.

2571.overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth, discovering that his reality is a simulated artificial world.

2959.overview: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground 'fight clubs' forming in every town, until an eccentric angel of death gets in the way.

4993.overview: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home behind to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator, the Dark Lord Sauron. Along with a fellowship of allies, he journeys toward Mount Doom.

58559.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

79132.overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets, is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: 'inception', the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

109487.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage. A father leaves his daughter behind on a dying Earth to find a new home for humanity across the stars.

48780.overview: A mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy -- full of obsession, deceit, and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.

48394.overview: Less than twenty-four hours into his parole, charismatic thief Danny Ocean is already rolling out his next plan: in one night, Danny's hand-picked crew of eleven specialists will attempt to steal more than $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos simultaneously in a lighthearted, clever heist.
